instagram.content:
“Therefore the kingdom of God is not food nor drink, but righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.” — Romans 14:17  

The Kingdom is not a future hope; it is the power that steadies your heart now. When the world offers distraction, the Spirit’s peace declares who truly rules you.  

What righteousness are you walking in today?

“Therefore the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people producing its fruit.” — Matt 21:43 NIV  
The throne isn’t a museum piece; it’s active. If we’re not bearing Kingdom fruit, the authority shifts.  
What fruit is God calling you to produce today?
